name: 老妈蹄花
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new standalone finished-dish illustration for a recipe art catalog: 老妈蹄花 (Sichuan pork trotter and white bean soup). The reference image is ONLY a style reference, do not repeat its food. Match the crisp deep-navy outlines, cute plump rounded food shapes, warm natural colors and restrained soft cartoon shading. Subject: a generous portion of tender pale ivory pork trotter chunks with recognizable rounded skin and small bone cross-sections, large white kidney beans, in opaque milky white soup with a few green scallion pieces. One ivory ceramic soup bowl with a slim sky-blue rim, viewed from above at a three-quarter angle. Food remains clearly illustrated, never photographic. Center the whole bowl on a square canvas with ample fully transparent margins, occupy around 82% of the canvas, no cropping. Strong simple silhouettes readable at 44px. Genuine transparent background outside bowl; no scenery, no checkerboard drawn into image, no text, no logos, no watermark, no cutlery, hands, people, faces, side dishes or garnish clutter. Do not draw tomato or egg from style reference.
